description: The splitting number is attained by a splitting family and is at most the size of every splitting family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.splittingNumber_spec :
  (∃ F,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.IsSplittingFamily F ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑F = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.splittingNumber) ∧
    ∀ (F : Set (Set ℕ)),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.IsSplittingFamily F →
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.splittingNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑F
